# Documentation sync

Docs change in the same change as the code. CI checks page shape and links (`python3 tool/check-docs.py`) and that a code change carries a CHANGELOG entry; it does not check that the text is still true, so the author who lands the code lands the docs.

## Surface to docs

| Code surface | Update |
|---|---|
| New or changed `ext.tapir.*` extension | `doc/commands/index.md` (and `doc/commands/tapir-<verb>.md` for a verb that has a page), `doc/mcp/tool-reference.md`, `llms.txt`, the matching README section, `skills/tapir/`, CHANGELOG |
| New `DowelCommand` or `McpToolDescriptor` | the same, plus the expected names in `test/tapir_dowel_provider_mcp_tools_test.dart` |
| Behaviour of an existing verb (flag, payload key, exit code, summary line) | its `doc/commands` entry, its `tool-reference.md` section, `skills/tapir/`, CHANGELOG |
| Actionability gate (new check, reason text) | `doc/reference/actionability-gate.md`, README "Actions and the actionability gate", CHANGELOG `Changed` with a migration note, CLAUDE.md Off-limits 5 and 6 |
| Frozen contract (CLAUDE.md Off-limits, or a perf pointer) | CHANGELOG `Changed` flagged breaking, CLAUDE.md Off-limits, `ARCHITECTURE.md` Invariants (perf pointers) |
| Magic or wind integration | `doc/plugins/magic-integration.md` or `doc/plugins/wind-integration.md` |
| Frame production, CDP or device presets | `doc/reference/frame-production.md`, README "Screenshots and web" |
| New export from `lib/tapir.dart` | CHANGELOG `Added` |

## Formats

- `CHANGELOG.md`: Keep a Changelog 1.1.0. New bullets go under `## [Unreleased]` in `Added`, `Changed`, `Deprecated`, `Removed`, `Fixed` or `Security`, with a bold lead sentence, then the why. A release promotes it to `## [X.Y.Z] - YYYY-MM-DD` with a footer compare link.
- `README.md`: front page, feature table, quick start; under 200 lines.
- `llms.txt`: H1 `# tapir`, a `>` summary, `**Stack**`, `**Setup**`, `## API`, `## Platforms`, `## Rules for agents`, `## Docs`, `## Links`. `## Docs` takes one line per page under `https://anilcancakir.com/tapir/docs/`; `## Links` may name GitHub, pub.dev and the changelog. Add a line for every new doc page.
- `doc/`: `doc/<section>/<page>.md` with lowercase slug names and one `#` heading as the first line, in the sections `getting-started`, `commands`, `mcp`, `plugins` and `reference`. `commands/index.md` covers every command; a verb with more to say gets `commands/tapir-<verb>.md`. `doc/api/` is dartdoc output and stays ignored.
- `skills/tapir/`: `SKILL.md` (frontmatter `name`, `description`, `version`, `when_to_use`; keep it short) plus `references/` for the long tables. Update both on a surface change.
